title: Embedding retrieval quality
description: Synthetic CrewFlow knowledge/memory corpus with labelled queries. Measures retrieval quality (precision@k, MRR, mean rank of first relevant) for local embedding models, compared conceptually against the production OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536-d) path. NOTE: OpenAI is NOT called; comparison is on dimensions, MTEB reputation (from public docs), and local latency only.

productionBaseline.note: Current CrewFlow embedding path per lib/ai/embeddings/openai.ts. Not called in this benchmark.

corpus.text: To add VAT to a quote, set your VAT rate in Settings then Tax; it applies automatically to new quotes, with a per-line override available.
CIS deductions are calculated automatically for subcontractors marked as CIS-registered; the deduction appears on their payment statement.
The client portal lets your customers view quotes, approve them, see invoices and download documents in bulk.
Member roles can see jobs and log costs, but money and profit reports and staff pay are restricted to admins only.
Offline mode queues your site-diary entries and photos while you have no signal and syncs them automatically when you reconnect.
To switch which company you are working in, use the organisation switcher at the top-left; this fixes invoice PDFs showing the wrong company.
Invoices can be voided with a full audit trail instead of being deleted, which keeps your accounts consistent for HMRC.
The dashboard shows your cash position, overdue invoices, job margins and upcoming payments at a glance.
Quotes older than 30 days are flagged so you can follow up on your open pipeline before they go cold.
Two-factor authentication can be enabled on any account from the security settings for an extra layer of protection.
The weather forecast appears on each job's schedule and flags likely rain days so you can plan outdoor work.
Material costs are logged against each job so you can see real-time margin versus the quoted budget.
You can set a default profit margin per client type in the quote builder so trade and retail quotes price correctly.
Appointment reminders are sent by SMS to clients ahead of a booked visit; timezones are handled automatically.
Supplier invoices can be scanned and the supplier, amount, VAT and category extracted automatically to save typing.
A loft conversion typically takes six to eight weeks and requires building control sign-off at structural stages.
Mini excavators and breakers are available to hire by the day; delivery and collection are charged separately.
Payroll figures in CrewFlow are estimates and do not yet include employer National Insurance or pension contributions.
To reduce material spend, compare supplier prices on your most-used products; small percentage differences add up at volume.
The recipe for a classic Victoria sponge involves creaming butter and sugar, folding in flour and baking at 180 degrees.
Premier League fixtures are scheduled across weekends with occasional midweek rounds during congested periods.
Photosynthesis converts carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen using energy from sunlight.
